F1: Post#cook` returns raw feed HTML unchanged, and nothing sanitizes it before it is rendered unescaped in the topic view and on the embed page (stored XSS).
F2: the URL is put inside `href='...'` without escaping, and `URI()` accepts a single quote, so a crafted feed link or embed URL can close the attribute and add new ones.
F3: Erubis emits a statement alone on its line with its trailing newline and no `;`, so `end if` takes the next statement as its condition and still parses; it does not raise a SyntaxError.
F4: the item loop has no per-item rescue and the job uses `retry: false`, so one bad item aborts every later item on each run, and the check-then-create in `import` can hit the unique `embed_url` index.
F5: inside the outer `Topic.transaction`, the `Rollback` from `save_post` is swallowed and `create` returns an unsaved post, so `present?` is true and `TopicEmbed.create!` fails on the NOT NULL `post_id`.
F6: embeddable_host` defaults to `''` and the controller rejects a blank host, so the nil == nil case can't be reached; the timeout and size-cap points name no concrete failure.
F7: cdn.example.com/x.png` passes `start_with?('/')`, its slashes get stripped, and it becomes a path on the source host.
F8: the `indexOf` test accepts any origin that is a prefix of `discourseUrl` (e.g. `https://forum.example.co`), so the origin check is wrong.
F9: the mapping still points at a trashed or destroyed topic, so for non-staff `find_topic` returns nil, `TopicView` raises NotFound, and the embed 404s for good.
F10: the topic now comes from `import_remote` with no `created_at` and no rescue around `open(url)`, so topics are dated at import time and one failed fetch aborts the whole run.
F11: force: true` only matters if the migration runs while the table already exists, which normal migrate and redo never do, so it causes no behavior defect.
